title: Review of Drug Testing Standards in Singapore
what_it_is: Review of Drug Testing Standards in Singapore

sections.label: HSA medicine quality standards
sections.summary: HSA sets stringent standards for medicines sold in Singapore, evaluating them against international standards of quality, safety and efficacy before approval.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Health Sciences Authority (HSA) sets stringent standards on the quality and safety of medicines sold in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Before being approved for sale, the medicines are evaluated to ensure that they meet the required international standards of quality, safety and efficacy.

sections.label: Losartan medicines recalled for NMBA
sections.summary: On 28 March 2019, HSA recalled three losartan blood pressure medicine brands after testing found NMBA above the acceptable limit.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: On 28 March 2019, HSA recalled three brands of medicines which belong to the angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) class of blood pressure medication and contain the ingredient losartan.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Following the recall of several losartan medicines in the US due to the presence of a nitrosamine impurity, N-nitroso-N-methyl-4-aminobutyric acid (NMBA), HSA tested the suspected losartan medicines and they were found to contain trace amounts of NMBA which are above the acceptable limit.

sections.label: Advisory to continue medicines
sections.summary: Because short-term risk was low, affected patients were advised to continue taking their medicines until suitable alternatives were provided.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As the short-term risk of taking the medicine was low, the advisory to affected patients was to continue taking their medicines until they are provided with suitable alternatives.

sections.label: Patients switching to alternatives
sections.summary: As of 28 April, more than half of affected patients had switched to alternatives, and institutions offered earlier appointments to those scheduled on or after 1 July.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As of 28 April, we have helped more than half of the affected patients switch to alternative medicines.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For all patients whose appointments are on or after 1 July, public healthcare institutions have already reached out to all of them to offer earlier appointments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We are on schedule to complete the exercise by end June this year.

sections.label: Losartan stock stabilisation date
sections.summary: Stock of losartan and other ARBs is expected to stabilise from 1 July onwards.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Just a question: when are we expecting the stock to be stabilised so that patients will not be inconvenienced by the current stock restriction policy?

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We expect the stock of losartan as well as other ARBs to stabilise from 1 July onwards.
